Export a CycloneDX 1.5 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

Source: R/sbom.R
export_sbom.Rd

Generates a standards-compliant CycloneDX 1.5 JSON Software Bill of Materials (bomFormat: "CycloneDX", specVersion: "1.5") enumerating every dependency layer of an R research project:

  • R packages with Package URLs (pkg:cran/..., pkg:github/..., pkg:gitlab/..., pkg:bioconductor/...) and renv.lock hashes when present.

  • OS apt system libraries (pkg:deb/debian/...) linked to the R packages that require them.

  • Python packages (pkg:pypi/...) discovered from requirements.txt or reticulate imports.

  • Scientific and compiled toolchains (R, CmdStan, Quarto, TinyTeX, JAGS, TMB/RTMB, C++, Rust, Python, Java).

Usage

export_sbom(
  path = ".",
  scan = NULL,
  manifest = NULL,
  output = NULL,
  format = c("cyclonedx"),
  spec_version = "1.5",
  include_base = FALSE,
  serial_number = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Path to the project root directory. Defaults to ".".

scan

Optional pre-computed rcapsule_scan object from scan_project(). If NULL, scans path.

manifest

Optional rcapsule_manifest object or path to capsule.json whose capsule_id and SHA-256 content digest are bound into the SBOM root component metadata.

output

Optional file path to write the CycloneDX JSON document (for example, "sbom.cdx.json"). If NULL, returns the SBOM object in memory.

format

SBOM output format; currently "cyclonedx" (default).

spec_version

CycloneDX specification version; defaults to "1.5".

include_base

Logical; if TRUE, also includes base R packages as components. Defaults to FALSE.

serial_number

Optional RFC 4122 UUID URN ("urn:uuid:...") for the BOM serial number. If NULL, generates a fresh cryptographic UUID v4 URN.

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_sbom containing bom (structured CycloneDX 1.5 list), json (pretty UTF-8 JSON string), path (written file path or NULL), spec_version, serial_number, and summary (component counts by ecosystem).

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_sbom_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines(c("library(jsonlite)", "library(stats)", "x <- 1:5"), file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
sbom <- export_sbom(tmp)
sbom
#> 
#> ── rcapsule CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM: rcapsule_sbom_19a97e864d83 ─────────────────────
#> • Serial number: "urn:uuid:4a50c18b-7d4b-44e1-8887-08590c8b4485"
#> • Total components: 2 (R=1, apt=0, PyPI=0, toolchains=1)
#> • Dependencies graph entries: 1
#> • Output file: <in memory>
validate_sbom(sbom)
#> 
#> ── CycloneDX SBOM Validation: VALID ────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Format: "CycloneDX" | Spec version: "1.5"
#> • Components: 2 | Dependency entries: 1 | Errors: 0
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
